scope: Distinct app-owned navigator screens, full-body state guarded forms, custom sheets, stepped forms inside those sheets, and confirmation/information dialogs with a source UI, entry, feature or data path. Internal/debug builds, direct-link-only legacy routes and platform-external UI are separate.
method: Independent reading of navigation, native auth wrapper, shell gates, each dialog boundary, actual native callers and reducer/state branches. Expected rows were authored before reading current presentation output. One view per body/form; wrappers, repeated openers, repeated tab registrations and same shared dialog body do not add views. First body of a registered wizard is included in its route row. Line evidence pins the reviewed source, not runtime availability.
limits: This is a bounded source inventory, not a proof that a session can open every view. Feature flags, geography, account restrictions and server replies still apply.
No account mutations, permission prompts, logout, signup, reporting or secret generation were performed.

Not counted as separate screens: loading/empty/error variants inside the same form, inline route tabs, menus/selects/tooltips/autocomplete, keyboard, native OS pickers/share sheet, browser pages. Full-page shell gates and separately presented prompts remain counted.
A shared sheet container is not proof of all its nested states. Ambiguous generic controls or collapsed destination keys are not counted as exact matches.
Expected list can have human omissions; evidence and exclusions make it reviewable and repeatable at this revision.
adjudication: After the first comparison, source review of unclassified wrappers added moderation appeal and suspension/gate bodies, split the eleven fixed notification settings subjects, added the nested moderation label appeal form, and linked existing shared report/trending/composer bodies to their caller identities. This corrected reference omissions and selectors, not production extraction. The complete catalog comparison adds exact JSX caller selectors for six shell gates, drawer and lightbox, and exact condition/side/body selectors for five server-result forms. These eleven rows previously had no testable selector. It also corrects the case of Wizard/State.tsx and pins the invite announcement to its own Dialog.Outer at line 84, not its wrapper or the shared invitation dialog.
